basis: ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: town-nearby acreage allocates its state-owned total by recorded population, with a stable per-world 0.5-1.5 spread; it is not measured county acreage. Four missing island-area totals use national state-owned acres per resident. Access expands service on the filed fraction of these acres. Visits per serviced acre use the 2023 NC state-park average, not a causal estimate. Management proposals use FY2023 NPS operating budget authority $2.995 billion / 85 million acres; this is a state-land proxy, not measured state costs. Visitors spend the NPS 2024 gateway average $29 billion / 331,863,358 visits.
businessWeightBasis: NPS 2024 lodging plus camping $11.7 billion and restaurants $5.7 billion. PLACEHOLDER: remaining $11.6 billion split 60:40 between retail (gas, groceries, goods) and recreation (outfitters, rentals and transport), a declared category-mapping estimate.
